newsitem.title: USA: Libbey sees Q3 EPS near flat. [CORRECTED 14:47 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Libbey sees Q3 EPS near flat. [CORRECTED 14:47 GMT]

text.p: Libbey Inc said Tuesday it expects third quarter net income to be at or near $0.64 per share, including common stock equivalents, experienced in the year-ago period. (Corrects from "at or near $0.64 per share, compared with $0.66 in the year-ago period.")

The company attributed the "flat net income" to various factors, including duplicative labor and systems costs associated with its re-engineering program, and sluggish performance at its Syracuse China subsidiary.
Costs associated with an August work stoppage at its Canadian facility and poor retail sales were also factors, the company said.
